_comment: the fixed label set the model may answer with. add a cause here, give it one line of meaning, and rerun eval - no code change needed.

causes.race: timing or ordering between processes; the operation raced another test or its own teardown
causes.infra: the machine, not the test: runner arch, mirrors, VM bring-up, storage of the runner
causes.network-timeout: a network operation timed out or was refused where the passing run succeeded
causes.designed: fails on purpose until a human acts, like a required-label gate
causes.test-bug: the test's own logic is wrong, like a wrong wait or a timestamp captured too late
causes.unknown: not enough evidence - say this rather than guessing
